 BTS's Swim is the best song of 2026.
 The title track of the album Arirang was selected by Apple Music as one of the top 100 songs of 2026 globally, making BTS the first K-pop group to achieve this feat.
 Báo Tuổi Trẻ • 11/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 The group's comeback song after a 4-year hiatus was selected for the list of best songs of 2026 - Photo: Big Hit Music
 On November 11th, Chosun reported that BTS's "Swim" was honored by Apple Music in its list of 2026 Best Songs .
 This is a compilation of 100 representative songs of the year, selected by the platform's editorial team, marking a new milestone for the Korean group in the international music market.
 Swim is also the first song by a South Korean group to appear on this global list.
 BTS "redefined K-pop"
 Its inclusion in this compilation acknowledges Swim 's popularity in 2026. Besides being on the list of the 100 best songs of the year, the song was also included in three of Apple Music's 2026 Best Playlists: A-List Pop, Viral Hits, and KPOPWORLD.
 You may also like Commenting on BTS's comeback with the album Arirang , Apple Music stated that this is the moment K-pop has been waiting for for a long time. The platform believes the group's return is the culmination of years of anticipation, and emphasized that BTS has redefined K-pop trends for 2026. 
 Apple Music showered praise on BTS's comeback - Photo: Big Hit Music
 Despite being released nine months ago, the album Arirang continues to be incredibly popular on US music charts. According to the Billboard charts, it ranked 62nd on the Billboard 200 as of November 14th.
 Arirang debuted at number 1 in April 2026 and held the top spot for three consecutive weeks. After 33 weeks, Arirang still maintained its ranking on Billboard's main album chart, and peaked at number 24 on Top Album Sales and number 30 on Adult Contemporary.
 Meanwhile, Swim climbed five places from last week, reaching number 28 on the Global 200, a chart that aggregates global streaming and digital music sales.
 On the Global (excluding the US) chart, the song ranked 14th. Another song from the album, " Normal," also appeared at number 114 on this chart. 
 Previously, Swim debuted at number 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, becoming BTS's seventh song to reach number one on the US main singles chart - Photo: Big Hit Music
 You may also like BTS released their album Arirang in March 2026 after all seven members completed their military service and reunited as a full group. By September, the group had won three awards at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards in Los Angeles, including Song of the Year, Best Group, and Best K-pop.
 BTS is currently on their BTS World Tour Arirang. The Southeast Asian leg is scheduled to begin on November 19th in Kaohsiung, followed by Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, and Jakarta. The group will hold a total of 15 shows in 5 cities.
